description: Welcome to GIS Gynix! We are expereinced in GIS & Remote Sensing with hands on expereince in the field. We are also experience in Python, SQL, React, Node.js, Spatial analysis and machine learning. Our strengths include analytical thinking, problem-solving, identifying patterns in datasets, and turning data into meaningful insights. Join us to combine technology, AI, and agricultural innovation to build a solution which can help our local farmers.
